limitations: Binary foreground semantics, physical scale, color statistics and lossy preprocessing must be justified for each application. A nonempty mask can enter the background sampling population. TIFF decoding and stain normalization are not implemented by this graph.

Group labels do not establish independence of subjects, acquisition sessions or sources. The caller must exclude validation overlap from pseudo sources; the implementation does not detect that overlap.

Encoder-state shape compatibility and deterministic seeds do not authenticate pretrained weights or prove accuracy. Explicit stage schedules and checkpoint roles must be executable. The graph stage functions use _train_stages directly and do not inherit all run_lifecycle selector validation.

Pseudo masks are model outputs, not independent ground truth. Positive-only filtering, area bins and augmentation invariance are recipe assumptions; application transfer requires justification and independent evaluation.

Batch composition, tile scale, padding, normalization and thresholds affect meaning and output. An empty final mask can result from the classifier shortcut; it is not evidence of absent foreground. Binary outputs are not calibrated uncertainty estimates.

resolved_source_corrections.tiling: Prepare decoded RGB/binary raster pairs using source unshifted and half-shifted grids, mask-area ordering, JPEG roundtrip and selected tile populations. Raster decoding is a caller boundary. Grid padding, source ordering and lossy preprocessing remain explicit; no arbitrary interchangeable tiler is claimed.
resolved_source_corrections.stain_normalization: Use source RGB/BGR conversion, JPEG preprocessing and fixed channel normalization in augmentation and inference. The intake stain-normalization claim is unsupported by the qualified source. Do not represent fixed channel normalization as stain normalization. This correction must be explicit in the corrected graph.
resolved_source_corrections.segmentation_architecture: Use full SE-ResNeXt101 encoder with custom decoder, attention and hypercolumns; execute initial folds, model restoration, generated pseudo masks and fresh retraining folds. Replace the intake DeepLabV3+/ResNeSt50 description with the source architecture. Initial training and pseudo-label retraining are required lifecycle stages omitted by the intake. Explicit encoder states are required; no automatic pretrained download.
resolved_source_corrections.lovasz_bce_loss: Train with binary BCE and per-image Lovasz hinge plus four nonempty-only deep supervision terms weighted0.1 and image-classification BCE. This is binary Lovasz hinge, not multiclass Lovasz-Softmax. Preserve auxiliary losses and their empty-mask gradient behavior.
resolved_source_corrections.tta_on_tiles: Use four flip views for pseudo labels and three for final prediction; average models and views before resize and strict binary thresholding. Pseudo and final inference policies differ. Batch-wide classification shortcut and ensemble order remain source assumptions; binary masks are not calibrated probabilities.
resolved_source_corrections.gigapixel_stitching: Prepare padded inference grids in bounded batches and write predicted interiors into a full-size binary output mask. Full decoded source and output arrays remain resident. No TIFF streaming, unbounded-size memory guarantee or source-codec qualification is implied.

qualification.reuse_decision: The recipe may transfer to other binary raster-segmentation tasks with justified foreground semantics, physical scale, color and augmentation assumptions, independent grouped populations and pseudo-source isolation. Keep explicit stage and inference policies. Generic image or sampling operations require independent qualification before standalone selection.

input_contracts.name: slides
input_contracts.constraints: Ordered decoded RGB uint8 raster and aligned binary uint8 mask pairs. Caller defines foreground meaning and physical scale. Source preparation uses unshifted and half-shifted grids, JPEG roundtrip, std>10 filtering and rounded-area bins. Both foreground-bin and background-bin training populations must remain.

input_contracts.name: groups
input_contracts.constraints: One string or integer group label per labeled raster. Validation groups hold out whole rasters before tiling; both partitions must retain tiles. Caller must establish subject/acquisition independence and exclude validation overlap from pseudo sources.

input_contracts.name: initial_stages
input_contracts.constraints: Nonempty ordered FoldStage objects with explicit full encoder tensor state, integer model seed, validation group labels and training options. Options include positive ordered start/end epochs, maximum_bin, batch sizes, input_side, explicit Python Random, NumPy RandomState and CPU Torch Generator. Training batch size is at least2 and model input dimensions are multiples of32. Every fold constructs a fresh decoder, Adam optimizer and scheduler.

input_contracts.name: initial_selectors
input_contracts.constraints: Nonempty ordered pairs of configured fold index and actually produced checkpoint role. Roles are best_loss, best_score or snapshot_<epoch>. These stage adapters do not perform the separate run_lifecycle selector precheck. Invalid selectors must not be supplied; tensor-compatible checkpoints do not establish pretrained provenance.

input_contracts.name: tile_size
input_contracts.constraints: Integer tile side at least2; source default1024. Both source grid offsets must produce a nonempty grid for each raster. Tile scale changes target meaning and sampling, so application transfer requires justification.

input_contracts.name: input_resolution
input_contracts.constraints: Positive integer model input side compatible with the network, normally320 and a multiple of32. It must agree with inference_geometry.input_resolution. This interface does not check that agreement before model execution.

input_contracts.name: pseudo_sources
input_contracts.constraints: Ordered collections of decoded RGB uint8 rasters from caller-approved pseudo populations. Caller must prevent validation overlap. Four-view predictions become binary masks; only rounded-bin-positive pseudo tiles are later appended to training.

input_contracts.name: pseudo_rng
input_contracts.constraints: Mapping with python_rng as Python Random and torch_generator as CPU Torch Generator. Streams are consumed by inference; callers control and preserve their lifecycle. No hidden global seed or device scheduling equivalence is promised.

input_contracts.name: inference_geometry
input_contracts.constraints: None or a mapping containing only resolution, input_resolution, pad_size and batch_size. Defaults are1024,320,256,12. Positive integer sizes and batch size are required; padding must satisfy0<=pad_size<resolution/2. Model and inference input resolution must agree; whole decoded input and output rasters remain resident.

input_contracts.name: retraining_stages
input_contracts.constraints: Nonempty ordered FoldStage objects with the same explicit encoder, grouping, schedule and RNG contract as initial stages. Retraining constructs fresh model/optimizer state and appends positive pseudo tiles; it does not continue the initially trained segmentation model.

input_contracts.name: final_selectors
input_contracts.constraints: Nonempty ordered pairs of retraining fold index and actually produced checkpoint role, preserving ensemble order. Callers must select checkpoints produced by their explicit schedule. Historical notebook checkpoint selection is not authenticated by shape compatibility.

input_contracts.name: final_images
input_contracts.constraints: Ordered decoded nonempty RGB uint8 rasters for final prediction. Foreground semantics, color/normalization, physical scale and augmentation invariance must be justified for the new application.

input_contracts.name: final_rng
input_contracts.constraints: Mapping with python_rng as Python Random and torch_generator as CPU Torch Generator, consumed during final inference. These are mutable trusted runtime objects, not JSON values.

output_contracts.name: initial_metrics
output_contracts.constraints: Ordered per-fold epoch records with training and validation aggregates plus checkpoint/early-stop decisions. These are training diagnostics, not independent predictive-quality evidence.

output_contracts.name: retraining_metrics
output_contracts.constraints: Ordered per-fold epoch records after fresh training with positive pseudo tiles. Validation metrics do not prove independence of caller-supplied populations.

output_contracts.name: predictions
output_contracts.constraints: Ordered full-raster uint8 binary masks using three flip views, model averaging, resize, strict threshold0.5 and interior stitching. Empty masks may reflect the batch classifier shortcut. Outputs are not calibrated uncertainty estimates.
